scripts.setup: scripts/setup.sh && dotnet restore Xpathed.slnx --locked-mode && npm --prefix src/Web ci
scripts.build: dotnet restore Xpathed.slnx --locked-mode && dotnet build Xpathed.slnx --no-restore --configuration Release && npm --prefix src/Web run build
scripts.lint: dotnet build Xpathed.slnx --no-restore --configuration Release && npm --prefix src/Web run lint && npm run lint:scripts
scripts.lint:scripts: for script in scripts/*.sh; do sh -n "$script" || exit; done; for script in scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$script" || exit; done
